arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name AS customer, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id WHERE customers.country = 'FR' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name;
